title: Station lockers and plaza planting
caption: Eight coin lockers beneath the station notice display, and connected planting beds around the plaza.

sections.title: Station hall
sections.caption: The locker bank stands against the back wall, west of the ticket machines. The same fittings appear through the station cutaway from the forecourt.

sections.title: Plaza lawns
sections.caption: Four low planting beds join the tree groups around the ring and lane arms. The existing paths and tree positions stay in place.

sections.title: Before this pass
sections.caption: The previous station corner and separate pale lawn mounds.
